instructions: Inspect only the exact frozen pixels and do not open the source pages or use prior transcripts.
Transcribe every fully visible content line in visual reading order while preserving semantic punctuation and visible line breaks.
Do not reconstruct text that is vertically or horizontally clipped; record such material only as an uncertainty note.
Identify only pixel-supported DESTINATION, DAY_MARKER, ACTIVITY_PLACE, TIME_HINT and AREA_ADDRESS fields.
For every identified field, freeze a tight pixel region_xyxy and deterministic extraction rule; do not use a region that includes unrelated glyphs.
Cover every fully visible critical field in the three quality captures; do not select fields based on expected OCR success.
The low-confidence control is a separate downscaled real capture. Freeze its complete readable planned-place and day controls, but never mark them parity eligible.
Classify activity places as PLANNED, OPTIONAL, REFERENCE, EXCLUDED or PASS_THROUGH from visible wording only.
Mark a field parity eligible only when it is a clearly planned atomic place and fully readable.
List descriptions, URLs, fused routes and clipped fragments that must never be predicted as atomic places.
Do not call this human review or human evidence.

output_contract.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':'), no trailing newline
